title: Verification Application
description: Represents the status of an identity verification application for an account holder

created.description: Timestamp of when the application was created.

status.description:
KYC and KYB evaluation states.

Note: `PENDING_RESUBMIT` and `PENDING_DOCUMENT` are only applicable for the `ADVANCED` workflow.

updated.description: Timestamp of when the application was last updated.

ky_passed_at.description: Timestamp of when the application passed the verification process. Only present if `status` is `ACCEPTED`
